classification.source_level_rationale: The records are verbatim transcripts and audio recordings of actual parliamentary debates conducted by the National Council.
classification.resume: The document comprises two parliamentary question sessions recorded during the summer session of 2007, featuring questions by Carlo Sommaruga and Silvia Schenker on political advertising by the OFAS director and the conduct of federal office directors, respectively. The recordings are part of the National Council's debate protocols and belong to the Swiss Federal Archives' parliamentary record collection. The sessions were held on 11 June 2007.
